Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
Join activities on activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.pchembl_value is not null
Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid
Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4338' and target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Left Join compound_structures on compound_structures.molregno = activities.molregno
Left Join molecule_dictionary on molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno
Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
Sort by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, target_type, tax_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
Limit 1000
